newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Overseas Union Trust upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Overseas Union Trust upgraded.

text.p: Vickers Ballas recommended on Thursday upgrading the rating for Overseas Union Trust (OUT) to neutral because of expected loans growth and stronger-than-expected net earnings.

"We have forecast loans growth of 14 percent in 1997, followed by 15 percent in 1998. Loans growth in 1998 will be underpinned by the expected increase in car financing activities after the introduction of the Electronic Road Pricing System," Vickers Ballas said in a research note.
Vickers Ballas said OUT's 1996 net earnings exceeded market expectations by 27 percent and represented a 51-percent increase over the previous year.
Earnings grew to Singapore $18 million from S$12 million, largely due to lower corporate tax.
It attributed the growth to better operating revenue, which grew 33 percent to S$79 million.
Vickers Ballas forecast net earnings would rise by 17 percent to S$21 million in 1997 in light of healthy loans growth and higher interest income.
"However, there will be continued downward pressure on interest spreads as the intense competition in the car financing and housing loan markets continues," it said.
